copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 装上后，你的AI助手会新增一个Discord机器人通道，能通过Discord接收你的消息并回复。你需要手动创建Discord应用并配置令牌。
howto.when: 当你要求添加Discord机器人通道或设置Discord集成时触发。

say.note: 系统会开始安装和配置Discord集成。
系统会设置Discord通道以便通过机器人交流。
系统会引导你完成Discord应用创建和令牌配置。

howto.what_en: After installation, your AI assistant will gain a Discord bot channel, enabling it to receive your messages and reply via Discord. You need to manually create a Discord application and configure the token.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Discord bot channel or set up Discord integration.

say_en.text: Help me add a Discord bot channel.
say_en.note: The system will start installing and configuring Discord integration.

say_en.text: I want to chat with you via Discord.
say_en.note: The system will set up the Discord channel for bot communication.
